vault:configuration.vault:input: SELECT id AS section_record_id, name__v AS section_name, course__cr.name__v AS course_name, semester__c AS semester, start_time__c AS start_time, end_time__c AS end_time FROM course_section__c WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM registrations__cr WHERE CASEINSENSITIVE(student_name__c) = $\{student_name\} AND (registration_status__c = 'enrolled__c' OR registration_status__c = 'waitlist__c'))
